question: Que font les gens ?

parts.text: à une fête dans le jardin

notes: Noun 1 is singular 'le ballon' (the pill sits on one yellow balloon); in context it means a party balloon (ballon de baudruche). The model answer adds 'dans le jardin' (the garden is shown) because 'Ils dansent à une fête.' alone sounds thin in French; the adverbials could in theory swap order ('dans le jardin à une fête'), but only the given order is natural. In the first boxed frames the people sit at the snack table and drink rather than dance.
